# Rodrigo Quintanilha

Founder of **Nasqui Technologies** · Software Engineer · Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

I design and build software products and infrastructure for the game server and SaaS ecosystem, with a focus on security and performance.

---

## About

- Founder of Nasqui Technologies, a company building a multi-product ecosystem
- Experience in game server hosting, customer support, and virtualization infrastructure
- Active in the Brazilian Minecraft community as a plugin and tooling developer
- Currently deepening my knowledge in AI and LLM engineering
